headline: Underlying growth accelerates as FX swing sinks GAAP profit
summary_short: Guidewire's revenue for the quarter ended April 30, 2026 rose 26.9% y/y to $372.5M with ARR up to $1,147M, but GAAP net income fell 64.2% y/y to $16.5M ($0.19 diluted EPS) as other income swung to an $18.9M expense from $34.1M of income on a foreign-currency reversal.
summary_long: Revenue rose 26.9% y/y to $372.5M on cloud-transition and new subscription agreements; ARR reached $1,147M, up from $1,041M. Gross margin expanded to 64% from 62% as subscription/support revenue outpaced infrastructure and personnel costs. Operating income jumped to $30.6M from $4.5M (margin 8% vs 1%) as revenue growth outpaced a 16% rise in operating expenses. GAAP net income still fell 64.2% y/y to $16.5M ($0.19 diluted EPS) because other income swung to an $18.9M expense from $34.1M of income on a $52.9M FX swing, and the effective tax rate rose to 17% from 6%. The company repurchased $392.4M of stock over nine months, with $240.5M left under its new $500M buyback authorization. No forward guidance was given.
